context: The working directory is aem-boilerplate with an unstyled testimonial-carousel block (JS only). Tests whether the agent finds where block CSS goes and writes CSS that fits the project: scoped to the block, targeting the DOM decorate() produces, reusing the :root custom properties in styles/styles.css instead of duplicating their values, leaving page layout to section styles, and responsive mobile-first. Backing facts: facts.yaml (block-css-scoping, block-css-location, platform-wrapper-classes, css-targets-decorated-dom, root-custom-properties, block-layout-scope, mobile-first-breakpoints, block-variant-classes).

checklist.name: Block CSS location
checklist.description: Styles are in `blocks/testimonial-carousel/testimonial-carousel.css`, the file aem.js loads for the block. Fail if they are put in styles/styles.css, another file, or inline in the JS. styles/styles.css has no `testimonial-carousel` rules, and testimonial-carousel.js sets no inline styles and injects no `<style>` or stylesheet.

checklist.name: Block selector scoping
checklist.description: Every selector starts with `.testimonial-carousel` or `main .testimonial-carousel` (variant compounds like `.testimonial-carousel.dark` included). No bare element or unscoped class selectors such as `h2 { }` or `.item { }`.

checklist.name: No platform class names inside the block
checklist.description: Elements inside the block are not named with `-wrapper` or `-container` suffixes (e.g. no `.testimonial-carousel .testimonial-carousel-wrapper`). Those classes belong to the block's parent and section; targeting them from outside to adjust outer layout is fine.

checklist.name: Targets the decorated DOM
checklist.description: Selectors match the markup decorate() produces: `ul.items`, `li.item`, `blockquote.quote`, `.byline`, and the `p` elements inside them. Fail if the CSS styles classes or structure the JS does not create (e.g. invented `.author`, `.company`, `.testimonial-card`, or the authored `:scope > div > div` rows).

checklist.name: Uses root custom properties
checklist.description: Colors, font families and font sizes reference the custom properties defined in `:root` in the project's styles/styles.css (e.g. `var(--text-color)`, `var(--dark-color)`, `var(--body-font-family)`, `var(--heading-font-size-s)`), including in the dark variant.

checklist.name: No duplicated root values
checklist.description: The CSS does not hardcode a value that already exists as a `:root` property: no `#131313`, `#505050`, `#f8f8f8`, `white` (as background), `roboto`/`roboto-condensed` font names, or the root font-size pixel values. Values with no `:root` equivalent are fine.

checklist.name: No undefined custom properties
checklist.description: Every `var(--x)` used is either defined in styles/styles.css or declared in the block CSS itself. No guessed names such as `var(--primary-color)` or `var(--font-body)` that exist in neither.

checklist.name: Section grid not overridden
checklist.description: The block does not fight the page grid set by global section styles (`main > .section > div`): no outer `max-width`, `margin: auto`/`margin-inline: auto` centering, or negative/outer margins on the block root. If the block needs a different outer layout (e.g. full bleed), it targets `.testimonial-carousel-container` or `.testimonial-carousel-wrapper`. Padding inside the block, including on the block root, is fine.

checklist.name: Mobile-first
checklist.description: Default (unqueried) styles give the single-column mobile layout; wider layouts are added in `min-width` or `width >=` media queries. No max-width-only queries for the core layout.

checklist.name: Project breakpoints
checklist.description: Media query widths come from the project (900px, as used in styles/styles.css) or the 600px/900px/1200px convention. Fail on arbitrary values such as 768px or 1024px.

checklist.name: Variant as block class
checklist.description: The dark variant is styled with a compound selector on the block, `.testimonial-carousel.dark` (optionally prefixed with `main `), not an attribute, a descendant `.dark`, or a separate block name.
